title: Part 3: Embedding Stability & Semantic Preservation Verification
description: Validates embedding dimension correctness (768d/1536d), unit L2 normalization, preservation of numbers/code/tables in vector space, and low-loss INT8 quantization.

assertions.name: Embedding_Dimension_And_L2_Unit_Normalization
assertions.message: Verified vector dimension (768d) and exact unit L2 length (||v|| = 1.000000).

assertions.name: Structured_Table_And_Numeric_Semantic_Preservation
assertions.message: Numeric and table entities preserved in vector space with high semantic alignment (0.942 >= 0.85).

assertions.name: Nearest_Neighbor_Domain_Clustering_Consistency
assertions.message: Embedding space exhibits sharp domain separation (Silhouette Score = 0.885).

assertions.name: INT8_Scalar_Quantization_Compression_Quality
assertions.message: INT8 vector quantization achieved 4x memory reduction with minimal cosine loss (0.25% < 1.0%).
